2610.06535.title: Symmetry and AI-assisted discovery of magic-state factories
2610.06535.paper_summary: Magic-state distillation is a major resource cost in fault-tolerant quantum computing. The cost of a magic-state factory depends strongly on its failure rate, which grows with the number of input magic states. Although symmetry-restricted methods have recently made distance two searches tractable, distance three and above have remained elusive at moderate input counts. We develop symmetry- and AI-assisted methods to search this regime. We present a unified binary-matrix formulation encompassing both triorthogonal-code and direct circuit searches. We show that distance at least three is equivalent to nonzero, pairwise distinct syndromes, separating the choice of syndromes from the search for compatible output gates. We restrict the syndrome search using group symmetry and language-model agents, followed by deterministic solving and independent verification. Our searches yield 699 factory classes, including 564 new ones. These include factories for pure-T states and factories with entangled outputs comprising combinations of T, CS, and CCZ magic states. The pure-T factories [[63, 11, 3]] and [[850, 128, 6]] achieve the lowest overhead exponents we know among protocols with at most 100 and 1000 inputs, respectively, with $γ= 1.589$ and $γ= 1.057$. Our [[1715, 287, 6]] factory, with $γ= 0.998$, is the smallest known pure-T factory with $γ< 1$. We also provide a context directory of search briefs and campaign notes with which readers can train their own agents and tailor the search to their requirements. With these results, we begin constructing an active, open-source repository of magic-state distillation protocols for the quantum community, supplemented by our methods and data, for the practical fault-tolerant quantum computing regime.
2610.06535.paper_summary_zh: 魔法態蒸餾是容錯量子計算中的一項主要資源成本。魔法態工廠的成本強烈依賴於其故障率，而故障率隨著輸入魔法態的數量而增長。儘管最近對稱限制方法使得距離二的搜尋變得可行，但距離三及以上在中等輸入數量下仍然難以捉摸。我們開發了對稱和人工智慧輔助的方法來搜尋這個範疇。我們提出了一個統一的二元矩陣公式，涵蓋了三正交碼和直接電路搜尋。我們展示了距離至少三等同於非零且成對不同的綜合徵，將綜合徵的選擇與兼容輸出閘的搜尋分開。我們利用群對稱性和語言模型代理來限制綜合徵搜尋，然後進行確定性求解和獨立驗證。我們的搜尋產生了699個工廠類別，其中包括564個新類別。這些包括純 T 狀態的工廠和具有糾纏輸出的工廠，這些輸出由 T、CS 和 CCZ 魔法態的組合組成。純 T 工廠 [[63, 11, 3]] 和 [[850, 128, 6]] 在我們所知的最多 100 和 1000 個輸入的協議中，分別達到了最低的開銷指數 $γ= 1.589$ 和 $γ= 1.057$。我們的 [[1715, 287, 6]] 工廠，$γ= 0.998$，是已知的最小純 T 工廠，且 $γ< 1$。我們還提供了一個搜尋簡報和活動記錄的上下文目錄，讀者可以利用這些資料訓練自己的代理，並根據自己的需求調整搜尋。通過這些結果，我們開始構建一個活躍的開源魔法態蒸餾協議庫，為量子社群提供補充我們的方法和數據，以支援實際的容錯量子計算範疇。
